지갑.x: I got a wallet as a birthday present.

잃어버리다.x: I lost my wallet on the subway.
잃어버리다.e: 잃다 (lose) + 버리다 (throw away), adding a 'gone for good' feel.
잃어버리다.t: Pronounced [이러버리다]. Don't confuse with 잊어버리다 'to forget'.

낫다.forms: 나아요 · 나았어요 · 나을 거예요 · 나으세요 (ㅅ irregular)
낫다.m: to get better, to recover, to heal
낫다.ex: 약을 먹고 푹 쉬었더니 감기가 다 나았어요.
낫다.x: I took medicine and got plenty of rest, and now my cold is all better.
낫다.e: Homonym: the adjective 낫다 means 'to be better (than)' and conjugates the same way.
낫다.t: The classic get-well wish is 빨리 나으세요! = Get well soon!

아쉽다.m: sorry (that something ends or is missed), a pity, regretful
아쉽다.x: It's such a shame the trip is already over.
아쉽다.t: 아쉽다 has no perfect English match: think 'what a pity' or 'I wish it had lasted longer'.

벚꽃.ex: 사월에는 벚꽃을 보러 공원에 많이 가요.
벚꽃.x: In April, lots of people go to the park to see the cherry blossoms.

연락처.x: Please write your name and contact number here.
연락처.t: Pronounced [열락처]; asking 연락처 좀 알려 주세요 is a polite way to ask for a number.

동영상.ex: 저는 인터넷 동영상을 보고 요리하는 방법을 배웠어요.
동영상.x: I learned how to cook by watching videos online.
동영상.t: Film a video is 동영상을 찍다; watch one is 동영상을 보다.

옷가게.x: I bought pants at a clothing store downtown.

표정.ex: 선물을 받은 동생의 표정이 아주 밝았어요.
표정.x: My little brother's face lit up when he got the present.
표정.t: 표정 is the look on your face; 표현 is expressing something in words or art.

한강.ex: 날씨 좋은 날에는 한강에서 치킨을 시켜 먹어요.
한강.x: On nice days we order chicken and eat it by the Han River.
한강.e: The hanja 漢 is usually explained as a way of writing the native word 한 'big'. It is not 韓 'Korea'.
한강.t: Picnics in the riverside parks (한강공원), with chicken delivered right to the riverbank, are a Seoul classic.

처방전.ex: 의사가 준 처방전을 가지고 약국에 갔어요.
처방전.x: I went to the pharmacy with the prescription the doctor gave me.
처방전.t: In Korea you get a 처방전 at the clinic, then take it to a separate 약국.

반창고.x: I cut my finger with a knife, so I put on a Band-Aid.
반창고.t: In everyday speech many Koreans just say 밴드.

눈썹.x: That actor has dark, thick eyebrows.
눈썹.e: Starts with 눈 'eye': the hair above the eye. Eyelashes are 속눈썹, 'inner eyebrows.'

채식.ex: 제 친구는 고기를 안 먹고 채식을 해요.
채식.x: My friend doesn't eat meat; she's vegetarian.

존중하다.ex: 다른 사람의 의견을 존중하는 것이 중요해요.
존중하다.x: It's important to respect other people's opinions.
존중하다.t: 존중하다 is respecting rights or opinions; 존경하다 is admiring someone, like a teacher or parent.

퇴직금.x: He opened a small shop with his severance pay.
퇴직금.t: In Korea, workers who stay a year or more are legally owed 퇴직금 when they leave.

기획안.ex: 다음 주까지 새 상품 기획안을 내 주세요.
기획안.x: Please submit the new product proposal by next week.

수입품.x: This store sells imported goods cheaply.

구독.ex: 그 채널이 좋아서 구독 버튼을 눌렀어요.
구독.x: I liked the channel, so I hit the subscribe button.
구독.e: Literally 'buy to read': first used for newspapers, now for channels too.

진통제.x: My head hurt so much that I took a painkiller.
진통제.e: Literally 'pain-suppressing drug'; -제 = drug/agent: 진통제, 소화제, 해열제, 수면제.

보상금.ex: 공사 때문에 이사한 주민들은 보상금을 받았어요.
보상금.x: Residents who moved because of the construction received compensation.

믿음직스럽다.x: My son became more dependable after coming back from the military.
믿음직스럽다.e: 믿음직하다 with -스럽다 'seeming'; the meaning is almost the same.

융통성.ex: 일을 할 때는 융통성이 있어야 해요.
융통성.x: You need to be flexible when you work.
융통성.e: Literally 'the quality of blending and flowing through' — adapting to circumstances.
융통성.t: Pronounced [융통썽]; 융통성이 없다 'inflexible' is the most common pattern.

신속하다.x: We will respond promptly to customers' inquiries.
신속하다.t: Pronounced [신소카다]; common in formal service language as 신속하게 or 신속히.

뚫다.m: to drill, to pierce, to bore through; to break through; to unclog
뚫다.x: I went to an accessory shop to get my ears pierced.
뚫다.t: Pronounced [뚤타]; the ㅎ is silent before a vowel: 뚫어요 [뚜러요].

부적절하다.x: That kind of joke is inappropriate in a meeting.

고개를 끄덕이다.forms: 고개를 끄덕여요 · 고개를 끄덕였어요 · 고개를 끄덕이며 (while nodding)
고개를 끄덕이다.m: to nod (one's head); to agree, to show approval
고개를 끄덕이다.ex: 선생님의 설명을 듣고 학생들이 고개를 끄덕였어요.
고개를 끄덕이다.x: After hearing the teacher's explanation, the students nodded.
고개를 끄덕이다.e: 고개 = the head; 끄덕 imitates the up-and-down nodding motion.

세탁물.m: laundry (items to be washed or cleaned)
세탁물.x: Please come pick up your laundry tomorrow afternoon.
세탁물.t: Pronounced [세탕물] — nasalization; it's a more formal word than everyday 빨래.

친정.m: a married woman's parents' home; her birth family
친정.x: I visited my parents' home with my husband for the holiday.
친정.e: Literally 'parents' courtyard' — the home a married woman grew up in.
친정.t: Used only from a married woman's point of view; her husband's family home is 시댁.

삼각관계.x: A love triangle has started in the drama, and it's so frustrating.
삼각관계.t: Pronounced [삼각꽌계]. A staple plot device of romantic K-dramas.

권력.x: All power comes from the people.
권력.t: Pronounced [궐력] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

타협.ex: 두 정당은 오랜 협상 끝에 타협했습니다.
타협.x: The two parties compromised after long negotiations.
타협.t: Useful collocation: 타협점을 찾다 = to find a middle ground.

건국.x: Gojoseon is said to have been founded in 2333 BC.

파장.ex: 빨간색 빛은 파란색 빛보다 파장이 길어요.
파장.x: Red light has a longer wavelength than blue light.
파장.t: In news, 파장이 크다 means 'the repercussions are big', e.g. after a scandal.

서비스업.ex: 요즘은 서비스업에서 일하는 사람이 가장 많아요.
서비스업.x: These days, the most people work in the service industry.
서비스업.t: Konglish note: 서비스 alone often means 'something free on the house' at restaurants.

화풍.ex: 그 화가의 화풍은 시간이 지나면서 크게 변했어요.
화풍.x: That painter's style changed greatly over time.
화풍.e: Literally 'painting wind'; -풍 = style or air: 화풍, 한국풍.

지칭하다.m: to refer to, to designate, to call
지칭하다.ex: 'MZ세대'는 1980년대 초부터 2000년대 초 사이에 태어난 세대를 지칭합니다.
지칭하다.x: 'MZ Generation' refers to people born between the early 1980s and early 2000s.
지칭하다.e: Literally 'point and call' — naming what you point at.

오죽.x: How hard must it have been for him to quit his job?
오죽.t: Almost always in 오죽 ~(으)면: 'it must have been really bad, if…'

인식론.ex: 인식론은 우리가 무엇을 어떻게 알 수 있는지 묻습니다.
인식론.x: Epistemology asks what we can know and how.

애국지사.ex: 광복절에는 애국지사들의 묘역을 찾는 사람이 많아요.
애국지사.x: On Liberation Day, many people visit the graves of the patriots.
애국지사.e: Literally 'person of strong will who loves the country'.

연목구어.m: a futile attempt, looking for something in the wrong place
연목구어.ex: 노력 없이 성공을 바라는 것은 연목구어예요.
연목구어.x: Hoping for success without effort is like climbing a tree to catch fish.
연목구어.e: From Mencius: 'climbing a tree to look for fish'.

지록위마.m: twisting the truth through power, deliberately calling black white
지록위마.x: No one dared object when the powerful man twisted the truth.
지록위마.e: Literally 'pointing at a deer and calling it a horse' — a Qin minister testing loyalty.

돈독하다.m: close, strong, deep (of friendship or ties)
돈독하다.ex: 두 나라는 오랫동안 돈독한 관계를 유지해 왔습니다.
돈독하다.x: The two countries have maintained close ties for a long time.
돈독하다.t: Used for bonds, not people: 우정이 돈독하다, 돈독한 관계. Pronounced [돈도카다].

윤곽.x: The outline of the new project has started to emerge.
윤곽.e: Literally 'rim and outer wall': the outer edge of something.

토붕와해.ex: 지도자가 떠나자 그 조직은 순식간에 토붕와해되었습니다.
토붕와해.x: Once the leader left, the organization completely fell apart.
토붕와해.e: Literally 'earth crumbles and roof tiles shatter.'
토붕와해.t: Usually takes 되다: 토붕와해되다 'to collapse completely.'

말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.de: 말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.rom: mal hanmadiro cheon nyang bijeul gamneunda
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.pr: 말 한마디로 천 냥 비즐 감는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.forms: 말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다고 · 말 한마디에 천 냥 빚을 갚는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.m: the right words can work wonders (lit. one word can repay a debt of a thousand nyang)
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.ex: 말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다고, 먼저 진심으로 사과해 보세요.
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.x: The right words can work wonders, so try apologizing sincerely first.
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.e: 냥 (兩) was an old unit of money, and a thousand 냥 was a fortune; yet one well-chosen word can settle such a debt.
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다.t: Pronounced [말 한마디로 천 냥 비즐 감는다]. Stresses that a sincere apology, thanks or tactful word can solve big problems. Also quoted as 말 한마디에 천 냥 빚 갚는다.
rel: 가는 말이 고와야 오는 말이 곱다
speak kindly and you'll be spoken to kindly
nb: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다
낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 쥐가 듣는다
열 길 물속은 알아도 한 길 사람 속은 모른다
